recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It fixes the remaining FHIR-47772 application defect without expanding into unresolved location work or unrelated DeviceAssociation search-parameter cleanup.
issue_request: FHIR-47772 requested the ability to search DeviceAssociation records by association time period, including open-ended periods, and was Applied as Persuasive with Modification with direction to follow the regular date/time search-parameter pattern.
initial_application: Commits 24ff431171 and a0e157b548 added DeviceAssociation-date and corrected its description, but the SearchParameter url remained copied from DeviceAssociation-code even though the id, code, type, and expression were for the date parameter.
additional_context: DeviceAssociation is active in source/fhir.ini and the DeviceAssociation search-parameter bundle is in current build scope. OO WGM minutes confirmed the 12-0-2 motion for date/time search-parameter handling. FHIR-47773 was encountered as an adjacent location-search request but remains Triaged and unresolved. Later normative-prep work changed standards statuses without addressing the copied URL.
reconciliation: Changed source/deviceassociation/bundle-DeviceAssociation-search-params.xml so DeviceAssociation-date uses http://hl7.org/fhir/build/SearchParameter/DeviceAssociation-date while preserving the approved code date, type date, expression DeviceAssociation.period, and description.
source_changes: source/deviceassociation/bundle-DeviceAssociation-search-params.xml: changed the DeviceAssociation-date SearchParameter url from DeviceAssociation-code to DeviceAssociation-date.

related_jiras.note: Adjacent DeviceAssociation location-search request discussed in the same OO minutes; it remains Triaged/unresolved and was not in scope for this date-search fix.
